eas_text: A civil authority has issued A FIRE WARNING for the following areas: Beauregard, LA; at 12:58 PM on AUG 25, 2023 Effective until 12:58 PM AUG 26, 2023. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: Beauregard Parish Sheriff's Office has ordered a mandatory evacuation order for the Bancroft community/area due to wildfires. This notice effect all residents. It is of the utmost importance to get out now. Please drive safely as you evacuate. Please evacuate the Bancroft community/areas asap
